podcast.title: James Bond Theme (1962)
podcast.body: In 1962, composer Monty Norman adapted an earlier song he had written, "Good Sign, Bad Sign," by adding a twangy guitar to create the theme song for the new James Bond movie. "In 1962 a composer named Monty Norman was asked to come up with a theme song for a new movie. He looked at a song he'd written called Good Sign, Bad Sign. Then he added a 20 guitar and submitted it to the producers."
